# PIPD_LS_DOC-00 — Navigation / Operator Entry — r2 High-Retention Full Repair

> **Repair posture:** This r2 preserves the r1 lifecycle/ownership spine and replaces the audited false-closure surfaces. DOC-00 remains a router/readback artifact, not a second lifecycle, TechnologyAdmission, evidence, handoff, qualification, release, or runtime SSOT.
# Five-Minute Router Card

| Does PIPD apply? | Use PIPD for pre-execution engineering of new systems/services/libraries, Skill/Plugin, Agent Harness, AI platform, brownfield migration, provider/tool changes, or any change needing traceable admission/evidence. | §2 | If task is purely explanatory or already covered by a current admitted WorkOrder/ECP, do not recompile a new lifecycle unnecessarily. |
| What state am I in? | Read canonical state + claim ceiling; do not infer from filenames or self-PASS text. | §3 + §8 + DOC-01 | Missing/stale state identity → fail closed. |
| What is my entry path? | Choose exactly one of eight quickstart paths. | §6 | First legal action must be identified before work continues. |
| What must a human read? | Router → Constitution → applicable PI/PD/Profile → Handoff → Conformance/Tooling as required. | §4.1 | Do not skip canonical owner. |
| What must an AI read? | Phase A global/read-only discovery → Phase B nearest-scope before action. | §4.2 | No first mutation before instructions + subject/hash/currentness + WO/ECP + permission + ExecutionAdmission. |
| What must a machine read? | Exact `.pipd` order begins at `lock/standard.lock.json` and ends at evidence/conformance. | §4.3 | Missing exact stage/path is a replay failure. |
| Can I mutate yet? | Only a matching, current `ExecutionAdmission=ADMIT` can authorize first mutation. | §12 / DOC-05 | `PI_READY`, `PREDEV_READY`, ECP, TQAEP, CI green, tool success are insufficient. |
| Which technology truth should I use? | Layer A = 22 canonical CAND; Layer B = 130 named donor/workflow identities; Layer C = project TechnologyAdmission instances. | §9–11 + App-B | DOC-00 never rewrites DOC-02 technology truth. |
| What if something drifted? | Re-enter via Quickstart 8; use affected-only invalidation and typed currentness/TT/CR. | §6.8 + §14 + §22–23 | No silent reuse of stale evidence/admission. |
**Eight entry paths:** `QS-01 Brand-new` · `QS-02 Existing PI` · `QS-03 PREDEV Binding` · `QS-04 Brownfield` · `QS-05 Skill/Plugin` · `QS-06 Agent Harness` · `QS-07 Vertical Slice` · `QS-08 Change/Drift Re-entry`.
# 0｜Artifact Identity, Authority, Lineage & Claim Boundary
## 0.1 Artifact role and version
This is the r2 high-retention repair of the r1 DOC-00 artifact. Its version is a DOC-specific materialization version and does not impersonate or supersede `PIPD-LIFECYCLE-SPEC@1.1.0`. The canonical standard and repaired blueprint remain upstream semantic authorities.
## 0.2 Repair controller
The r1 audit reported `3 BLOCKER / 9 MAJOR / 4 MODERATE` findings and explicitly required `HIGH_RETENTION_PATCH_NO_ARCHITECTURE_RESET`. This r2 therefore preserves r1 sections whose lifecycle/ownership logic audited as materially sound, while rebuilding denominator, quickstart, machine bootstrap, technology routing, source coverage, currentness, self-conformance, typed failure namespaces, and packaging identity.
## 0.3 Authority rule
Current patch instruction controls this delivery. For PIPD semantics: A1 repaired blueprint → A2 canonical standard → A3 repaired skeleton → A4 design history. The AUDIT is the repair controller for proven r1 defects. Web/currentness remains SUPPORT: it may update version/status/license/security/compatibility evidence but cannot silently change canonical terminal disposition or writer ownership.
## 0.4 Claim namespace
`FOREIGN_GRP_MOUNT_STATE_TOKEN` is removed. It is not a PIPD lifecycle/claim token. DOC-00 uses only PIPD-defined lifecycle/claim semantics plus the artifact-local namespaced status `DOC00_R2_FULL_SUBSTANTIVE_BODY_MATERIALIZED`.
## 0.5 Honest ceiling
This artifact is not target-repo-bound and provides no evidence that any named technology is installed, bound, enabled, executed, verified, qualified, released, human-ratified, independently accepted, or production-verified.
# 1｜Mission, Position & Non-Goals
PIPD exists to prevent semantic loss between intent and authorized implementation. DOC-00 exists to prevent a second class of loss: **navigation loss**—operators opening the wrong artifact, confusing planning with permission, reading a projection as authority, or starting implementation because a package looks complete.
DOC-00 therefore owns the package/document map, read order, bootstrap procedure, operator routing, state-readback projection, first-use quickstarts, and anti-pattern warnings. It reads lifecycle/claim truth from DOC-01, PI/TechnologyAdmission truth from DOC-02, PD/currentness/ECP/TQAEP truth from DOC-03, evidence truth from DOC-04, handoff/admission truth from DOC-05, profile truth from DOC-06, conformance truth from DOC-07, AI adapter/read-order truth from DOC-08, and CI/release/tooling truth from DOC-09.
Its non-goal is equally important: DOC-00 must never become the second writer for any of those domains. If a summary here appears to disagree with its canonical owner, the owner wins and the mismatch becomes a conflict/drift item; operators do not repair it by choosing whichever text is more convenient.
# 2｜Applicability & Complexity Governance Entry
PIPD applies when a change needs a pre-execution engineering contract: a new system/service/library, a meaningful feature, an AI-enabled platform, a Skill/Plugin, an Agent Harness, a brownfield modernization/migration, provider replacement, a high-risk operational change, or a custom target whose implementation must be traceable from intent through admission and evidence.
PIPD is not required merely to answer a conceptual question or to perform a previously admitted local action whose governing WorkOrder/ECP/permission/evidence contract is already current. Even then, the operator must not use this exception to bypass a required admission or change-control edge.
## 2.1 Weight profiles
- **LITE** — low-risk, isolated, reversible work. It may reduce documentation weight, but retains requirements/acceptance, permission boundary, rollback, evidence/claim separation, and no-first-mutation-before-admission.
- **STANDARD** — normal systems, services, libraries and agent applications. Uses the standard contract set with risk-appropriate assurance.
- **ASSURED** — high-risk, high-permission, regulated, physical, financial, identity/security-sensitive, or harness-level work. Adds stronger SoD, threat model, provenance/attestation, adversarial testing, containment, rollback drill, repeatable qualification and human gates where required.
## 2.2 Target profiles
- **SYSTEM** — conventional product/service/library/system engineering.
- **SKILL_PLUGIN** — requires explicit trigger/non-trigger, I/O, tools, permissions, dependencies, secrets/network, side effects, host boundary, compatibility, negative examples, disable/uninstall and residue contracts.
- **AGENT_HARNESS** — requires agent identity, loop, tool registry, context/state/memory, hooks, permission, handoff, guardrails, eval, observability, recovery, human escalation, interop and provider-neutral seams.

- **CUSTOM** — allowed only with an explicit extension that preserves core invariants.
- **Brownfield Migration specialization** — overlays existing-system discovery, shadow/pilot/parity, compatibility, rollback, provider exit and residue closure; it does not grant permission to mutate merely because the system already exists.
## 2.3 Reasoned N/A
A field or package may be N/A only when its canonical owner permits conditional applicability and the record states the target/profile reason. N/A cannot erase universal invariants such as authority separation, claim honesty, permission/admission, rollback for effectful actions, evidence identity, or source/currentness integrity.
# 3｜One Lifecycle — Operator Mental Model
The lifecycle is one chain; PI and PD are not two independent development methods.
```text
Intent / Need / Existing System
        ↓
Pre-Implementation (stable WHAT / WHY / architecture / requirements / acceptance)
        ↓
PI_READY
        ↓
Read-only RepoContext / Environment Binding
        ↓
Pre-Dev (late-bound repo/runtime/provider/version/environment/currentness + execution preparation)
        ↓
PREDEV_READY
        ↓
Execution Admission
        ↓
EXECUTION_ADMITTED
        ↓
Implementation / First Authorized Mutation
        ↓
Evidence Return
        ↓
Verification → Qualification → Release → Production Verification
```
### 3.1 Canonical state ladder
| State | Meaning | Normal next transition |
|---|---|---|
| `DRAFT` | Initial subject exists; contracts not compiled | `PI_COMPILING` |
| `PI_COMPILING` | Pre-Implementation contracts being compiled | `PI_READY` |
| `PI_READY` | Stable WHAT/WHY/architecture/requirements/acceptance compiled for target scope | `PREDEV_BINDING` |
| `PREDEV_BINDING` | Read-only repo/environment/provider/currentness binding | `PREDEV_READY` |
| `PREDEV_READY` | Pre-execution engineering complete for bound target; no first mutation yet | `EXECUTION_ADMISSION_PENDING` |
| `EXECUTION_ADMISSION_PENDING` | Receiver/permission/effect/rollback/evidence decision pending | `EXECUTION_ADMITTED or HOLD/DENY-equivalent decision record` |
| `EXECUTION_ADMITTED` | Bounded execution explicitly authorized | `IMPLEMENTING` |
| `IMPLEMENTING` | Authorized mutation underway | `IMPLEMENTED` |

| `IMPLEMENTED` | Implementation materialized; not yet verification truth | `VERIFYING` |
| `VERIFYING` | Subject-bound verification executing | `VERIFIED` |
| `VERIFIED` | Declared verification passed with required evidence | `QUALIFIED` |
| `QUALIFIED` | Qualification criteria passed | `RELEASED` |
| `RELEASED` | Release decision/materialization complete | `PRODUCTION_VERIFIED` |
| `PRODUCTION_VERIFIED` | Production evidence supports declared production state | `terminal/current until change invalidation` |
Side states are `HOLD`, `TEMP_CLOSED`, `REWORK_REQUIRED`, `REJECTED`, `SUPERSEDED`, `INVALIDATED`. They are typed truth states, not prose decorations. A side state blocks or redirects only the affected scope unless the canonical dependency graph requires wider invalidation.
### 3.2 Promotion rule
A state promotion is legal only when the canonical writer can demonstrate the required artifacts, typed fields, owner references, dependency closure, gates, zero blocking TT for the promoted scope, zero stale blocking dependency, applicable permission/admission, and subject/version/hash-bound evidence. Prose such as “ready” or a green third-party tool is not a promotion mechanism.
### 3.3 The decisive boundaries
- `PI_READY` means the stable design contract for the applicable scope is complete; it is not repo-bound and does not authorize execution.
- `PREDEV_READY` means pre-execution engineering for the bound target is complete; it is still not authorization for first mutation.
- `EXECUTION_ADMITTED` is the first state that authorizes bounded execution according to its exact admission scope.
- `IMPLEMENTED` says materialization happened; it does not say verification passed.
- `VERIFIED`, `QUALIFIED`, `RELEASED`, and `PRODUCTION_VERIFIED` each require their own evidence and authority.
# 4｜Read Order — Human, AI & Tool/Machine
## 4.1 Human order
`Router → Constitution → applicable PI / PD / Profile → Handoff → Conformance / Tooling as required`.
1. DOC-00 identifies subject, applicability, entry path, current state and next owner.
2. DOC-01 resolves authority/state/claim/SoD/invalidation.
3. DOC-06 resolves weight/target profile.
4. DOC-02 owns PI contracts and TechnologyAdmission.
5. DOC-03 owns RepoContext/currentness/S2E/WorkOrder/ECP/TQAEP.
6. DOC-04/07 own trace/evidence and tests/oracles.
7. DOC-05 owns receiver acceptance and ExecutionAdmission.
8. DOC-08/09 own AI consumption and CI/release/runbook/tooling projections.
## 4.2 AI/LLM two-phase order
**Phase A — Global / Read-Only Discovery**
1. Read canonical Lifecycle Constitution and manifest.
2. Resolve standard/profile version and target/weight profile.
3. Discover repo/workspace instructions read-only (`AGENTS.md`, nested instructions, policy files, package/build metadata).
4. Determine instruction applicability to intended target path/surface.
5. Read applicable PI package(s) and frozen handoff refs.
6. Read applicable PD package(s) and RepoContext binding.
**Phase B — Nearest-Scope Action Preparation**
7. Before any command/write/effect, read the nearest applicable nested instructions.
8. Resolve conflict: PIPD authority owns lifecycle semantics; repo-local instructions own local mechanics inside allowed scope; neither grants external authority.
9. Validate subject/version/hash/currentness, WorkOrder/ECP, permission/approval, rollback and evidence return.
10. Only an `EXECUTION_ADMITTED` subject may perform first authorized mutation/effect.
Unreadable applicable instruction surface → affected repo mutation is fail-closed, never guessed.

# 12｜ECP, TQAEP, Handoff & ExecutionAdmission Boundary
| Object | Purpose | What it may constrain/define | What it cannot do | Canonical route |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DEV ECP | Development Execution Control Package | mutation scope, commands, files, budgets, rollback, evidence return | self-authorize first mutation | DOC-03 → DOC-05 |
| OPS ECP | Operations Execution Control Package | install/bind/deploy/migrate/operate side-effect scope and rollback | self-approve deployment/operation | DOC-03 → DOC-05 |
| TQAEP | Test / Qualification / Acceptance / Evidence Package | tests, fixtures, oracles, evidence, qualification gates | claim that tests/qualification already ran | DOC-03 + DOC-04/07 |
| Execution Handoff | Explicit sender→receiver package | subject, scope, refs, assumptions, receiver checks | imply receiver acceptance | DOC-05 |

| ExecutionAdmission | Separate permission/admission decision | ADMIT/HOLD/DENY scope, permission/effect boundary | retroactively legitimize earlier mutation | DOC-05 |
`TaskSpecSeed`, S2E output, WorkOrder and ECP are distinct identities. A WorkOrder cannot self-authorize; an ECP cannot self-approve; TQAEP cannot self-qualify. The first mutation becomes legal only after a matching ExecutionAdmission is current.
For effectful operations, execution truth follows `AUTHORIZED_ATTEMPT → PROVIDER_RESPONSE → OBSERVATION → READBACK → RECONCILIATION → WORLD_EFFECT_STATE`. `UNKNOWN_EFFECT`, `PARTIAL_EFFECT` and `CONFLICTING_EFFECT` remain unresolved until re-observation, compensation/reconciliation or bounded failure closure. Provider/API success is not world-effect truth.
# 13｜Vertical Slice, Concurrency & Adoption Waves
PIPD rejects a global waterfall lock. A vertical slice may progress when its own semantic dependency closure, shared-writer constraints, currentness, profile obligations, permission/effect contract and admission are complete. Unrelated packages may remain in earlier states.
Concurrency is blocked only when slices share a canonical writer that cannot safely accept parallel changes, share an invalidation edge whose outcome can stale the other slice, compete for a non-partitionable resource/permission, or depend on an unresolved cross-slice contract. Otherwise, independent slices can compile, bind, admit, implement and verify independently.
A practical adoption wave is: **Wave 0 control/readback → Wave 1 one reversible slice → Wave 2 repeated slices with parity/evidence → Wave 3 high-risk/ASSURED surfaces → Wave 4 broader provider/interop rollout → Wave 5 release/ops hardening**. Each wave preserves provider-off/rollback and evidence return; later wave success does not retroactively validate earlier evidence if subject/version/hash changed.
# 14｜Failure / Degrade / Recovery — Typed Namespace Separation
The columns below are intentionally separated. `lifecycle_state`, `decision`, `degrade_status`, and `claim_ceiling_effect` are different namespaces and MUST NOT be injected into one another.
| Condition | lifecycle_state | decision | degrade_status | claim_ceiling_effect | recovery | forbidden shortcut |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Missing required source/anchor | unchanged | ABSTAIN | TEMP_CLOSED | NO_PROMOTION | Locate authoritative source/anchor; restore identity/hash; rerun owner decision | Infer semantics from lower authority. |
| Stale source/currentness | unchanged | HOLD | CURRENTNESS_STALE | NO_PROMOTION | Refresh official support; compare compatibility/security/license; invalidate affected evidence only | Continue on remembered latest version. |
| Authority conflict | unchanged | HOLD | AUTHORITY_CONFLICT | NO_PROMOTION | Route to canonical writer; apply precedence; record conflict | Silent merge. |
| Missing permission/approval | PREDEV_READY or current pre-effect state | DENY_OR_HOLD | BLOCKED_EXTERNAL | NOT_AUTHORIZED | Obtain valid scoped permission/approval and rerun admission | Treat ECP/UI confirmation as authority. |
| ECP exists, no admission | PREDEV_READY | WAITING_EXECUTION_ADMISSION | NORMAL | PRE_EXECUTION_ENGINEERING_COMPLETE | DOC-05 receiver/admission decision | Begin first mutation. |
| Source/hash drift | last honest lifecycle state | HOLD | INVALIDATED_AFFECTED_SCOPE | NO_REUSE_OF_STALE_EVIDENCE | Recompute identity; reverse-dependency impact; reverify affected scope | Reuse PASS/admission from old subject. |
| Validation failure | IMPLEMENTING/VERIFYING as applicable | REWORK_REQUIRED | VALIDATION_FAILED | NO_PROMOTION | Fix implementation/contract or controlled CR; rerun bound test | Lower threshold silently. |
| World effect unknown/partial/conflicting | current execution state | RECONCILE | WORLD_EFFECT_UNRESOLVED | NO_EFFECT_SUCCESS_CLAIM | Re-observe/readback/reconcile/compensate | Provider response = world success. |
| Provider unavailable | current state | HOLD | PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE | NO_PROMOTION | Use pre-admitted fallback/provider-off route; rebind/revalidate | Unapproved substitution. |
| Receiver NACK | PREDEV_READY / ADMISSION_PENDING | NACK | HANDOFF_REJECTED | NOT_AUTHORIZED | Resolve NACK reasons; issue new handoff identity | Sender declares acceptance. |
| Open blocking TT | unchanged | HOLD | TT_BLOCKING | NO_PROMOTION | Close TT with evidence or canonical scope change | Hide gap in prose. |
| CR required | unchanged | WAITING_CR | CHANGE_PENDING | NO_PROMOTION_IF_GATE_RELEVANT | Process CR and affected-only invalidation | Change standard/selection inside DOC-00. |
# 15｜Common Errors / Anti-Patterns
| Anti-pattern | Correct interpretation |
|---|---|
| `document = execution` | False. A document can be complete while runtime is untouched. |
| `design selected = installed` | False. TechnologyAdmission is a design decision; installation is a later effectful state. |
| `ECP = permission` | False. ECP constrains execution; ExecutionAdmission authorizes bounded execution. |
| `PREDEV_READY = execution admitted` | False. PREDEV_READY precedes a separate admission decision. |
| `sender ready = receiver accepted` | False. Receiver validation may NACK/HOLD. |
| `adapter = authority` | False. Adapter/projection resolves to canonical writers. |
| `CI green = product acceptance` | False. CI is an evidence host; acceptance remains canonical requirement/gate truth. |
| `same filename = same artifact` | False. Subject/version/hash identity controls evidence and supersession. |
| `web newest = semantic authority` | False. Web currentness may update version/risk facts; semantic changes require canonical change control. |
| `all packages must finish before any slice starts` | False. Dependency-closed slices may advance independently. |
| `TQAEP = Independent PASS` | False. It defines testing/qualification/evidence work; execution and independent judgment are separate. |
| `local document complete = production complete` | False. Production truth is the end of an evidence-bearing lifecycle. |

| Term | Canonical operator meaning |

| **OPS ECP** | Operational/install/bind/deploy/migrate execution-control package. |
| **TQAEP** | Test / Qualification / Acceptance / Evidence Package. |
| **Canonical Writer** | Unique owner allowed to write a typed decision/object’s normative truth. |
| **Claim Ceiling** | Highest claim supported by current evidence. |
| **TT** | Scoped tracked unresolved item; never hidden by vague prose. |

| **World effect** | Observed/reconciled external state, not merely provider/API success. |
| **Vertical slice** | Dependency-closed subset allowed to progress independently through the lifecycle. |

# 18｜Operator Scenarios
## 18.1｜New system from DRAFT into PI
A new service has approved product intent but no implementation contract. DOC-00 routes to DOC-06 for STANDARD/SYSTEM profile, then DOC-02. The team compiles PI-01..18, atomizes requirements and resolves TechnologyAdmission. State may move DRAFT→PI_COMPILING→PI_READY only when the applicable gate closes. No repo mutation occurs during this scenario.
## 18.2｜PI_READY into PREDEV_BINDING
A slice is PI_READY. The operator opens DOC-03, discovers repo instructions and RepoContext read-only, resolves current dependencies/provider versions and compiles S2E/WorkOrder/ECP/TQAEP. Any attempt to edit a source file before admission is rejected even though the design is complete.
## 18.3｜Skill/Plugin target
A new repository skill selects SKILL_PLUGIN profile. Trigger/non-trigger, tools, permissions, host boundary, network/secrets, side effects, examples, disable/uninstall/residue are mandatory. The skill file itself cannot grant tool permission; effectful actions still need WorkOrder/ECP/admission.
## 18.4｜Agent Harness target

A harness uses AGENT_HARNESS + ASSURED. Its loop, tools, state/memory, permission, guardrails, human escalation, recovery, interop, observability and adversarial tests are explicit. A provider’s own approval callback cannot replace DOC-05 admission.
## 18.5｜Brownfield migration
An existing provider must be exited. PI fixes desired semantics and migration acceptance; PD reads current repo/runtime, provider contracts and residue. Shadow/pilot/parity and rollback are defined. Each cutover wave gets separate receiver acceptance/admission and post-effect reconciliation.
## 18.6｜Vertical slice starts before global completion
Slice A depends only on shared API schema X and its own service. Slice B/C packages remain in PI. Once X and Slice A dependency closure are stable, Slice A reaches PREDEV_READY and receives admission; it may implement without waiting for unrelated B/C, unless a shared writer/invalidation edge becomes active.
## 18.7｜ECP exists but no ExecutionAdmission
DEV-ECP lists files, commands, rollback and evidence. The state readback has `execution_admission_ref: null`. DOC-00’s answer is unambiguous: execution is forbidden; next route is DOC-05.
## 18.8｜Currentness stale
A pinned dependency is older than the project currentness threshold and a security/compatibility check is stale. The affected binding enters HOLD/TEMP_CLOSED; the operator refreshes official sources and reruns compatibility. Stable PI product semantics do not change automatically.
## 18.9｜Technology selected but not installed
MCP is `ADOPT_WITH_TRANSLATION` in DOC-02. No MCP server/client exists in the target. DOC-00 displays `DESIGN_SELECTED` only; installation/binding waits for PD and admission. The system cannot claim MCP integration from selection alone.
## 18.10｜Source/hash drift
A WorkOrder and verification receipt reference source hash H1, but the repo now hashes H2. The dependent admission/evidence becomes stale/invalid for the changed scope. Reverse-dependency impact is recomputed; unrelated evidence remains valid if its subject did not change.
## 18.11｜Sender ready, receiver NACK
The sender marks its handoff ready, but receiver detects a missing rollback command and stale credential scope. Receiver NACK/HOLD is authoritative for admission. The sender repairs the handoff and issues a new identity; it does not override the receiver.
## 18.12｜Web new version without canonical selection change
A tool publishes a new release after currentness research. DOC-00 may record the new version/risk fact, but the canonical terminal disposition and selected compatibility policy do not change silently. If adoption semantics must change, DOC-02 processes a TechnologyAdmission/CR and downstream evidence is impact-checked.

# 3｜CommonArtifactMetadata Compatibility Superset / Identity & SoD Narrow Waist
## 3.1 Purpose and Design Intent
本節修補 r1 將 A2/A3 metadata 縮窄的 authority drift。所有 canonical/project artifacts MUST 使用 **compatibility superset**：不得在 `owner` 與 `canonical_owner`、`version` 與 `subject_version` 之間二選一丟欄；不得讓 `checker` presence 自動等同 Independent PASS。
## 3.2 Required Fields and Normalization
|Field|Semantics / invariant|
|---|---|
|`artifact_id`|stable artifact identity；filename不得作唯一 identity|
|`artifact_type`|machine-readable typed enum/profile|
|`subject_id`|governed subject identity|
|`version`|artifact revision/version|
|`subject_version`|subject version；若與 artifact version相同 MAY mirror，否則 MUST 明確區分|
|`status`|artifact-local materialization/status，不得偷渡 lifecycle claim|
|`lifecycle_state`|canonical subject state or `null`；不得填 operational/degrade label|
|`owner`|artifact operational owner；MUST normalize to canonical owner relationship|
|`canonical_owner`|single canonical writer/semantic owner|
|`source_refs` / `authority_refs`|source provenance 與 authority lineage 分離|
|`dependencies` / `consumers`|affected-only invalidation graph edges|
|`content_hash`|materialized bytes hash；self-contained file若採 detached hash MUST用 `detached_content_hash_ref`|
|`maker/checker/acceptor`|distinct SoD slots；`checker=null` 不代表失敗，代表未有 canonical checker claim|
|`release_authority`|release decision slot；不可由 acceptor隱含|
|`human_approver`|high-risk permission slot；不可由 release authority隱含|
|`weight_profile`|`LITE / STANDARD / ASSURED`（Markdown 中不用 raw pipe 作 cell separator）|
|`target_profile`|`SYSTEM / SKILL_PLUGIN / AGENT_HARNESS / CUSTOM`|
|`profile_version` / `extensions`|profile binding + typed extensions|
|`claim_ceiling`|governed subject claim only；artifact materialization claim MUST separate|
|`supersedes`|revision lineage；superseded bytes可保留 provenance 但不可 silent-current|
|`created_at` / `observed_at`|artifact creation vs observation/currentness timestamp|
## 3.3 Alias / Conflict Rules
1. `owner != canonical_owner` 時 MUST 有 delegation/operation rationale；不得讓 delegate取得 semantic overwrite authority。  
2. `version != subject_version` 時 MUST 記兩者各自作用域。

3. self-file `content_hash` 不能遞迴自嵌；本版使用 `detached_content_hash_ref`，最終 readback receipt 才給實際 SHA-256。  
4. same-model self-review MUST 寫入 `checker_kind=AUTHOR_SELF_REVIEW_ONLY`, `checker_independent=false`，且 canonical `checker` slot保持 `null`，除非真的有獨立 checker。  
5. `release_authority` 與 `human_approver` 為獨立 slots；ASSURED/high-risk 不得以 Maker/Checker/Acceptor 任一欄隱含替代。

## 4.2 Legal Entry / Exit Predicate
每一 state `S` 的 legal entry MUST satisfy `PromotionPredicate(previous,S)`；terminal or side-state handling不得 bypass canonical predecessor。`QUALIFIED` 另 MUST 具備 **TQAEP execution + qualified evidence + qualification authority**，不是 TQAEP planning completeness。
## 4.3 State-Specific Re-entry and Rollback
- semantic requirement/authority change：回到受影響最早 PI state；不得 global reset。
- repo/provider/env drift：回到受影響 PD binding state；PI semantics若未變保持 current。
- admission/token mismatch：回到 `EXECUTION_ADMISSION_PENDING`；不得改寫 `PREDEV_READY` truth。
- verification/qualification failure：`REWORK_REQUIRED/HOLD` 作 side-state；修復後回到 canonical parent context，而不是另造 lifecycle token。
- release/production drift：依 authority/effect evidence scoped invalidation，保留 prior provenance。
## 4.4 Per-State Positive / Negative Oracle Rule
每列的 positive case = predecessor合法 + §6十條全 true + required evidence appropriate；negative/apparent-pass = 任一 required evidence由文件宣告、tool success、stale/wrong-subject evidence取代。Stable test family=`TEST-B0C02A64`，state-specific semantic rules=`DOC01-STATE-001..014`。
# 5｜Side / Degrade States 與 Projection/Substate Mapping
## 5.1 Side / Degrade States
|State|Meaning|Canonical lifecycle effect|Exit path|Claim-ceiling effect|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`HOLD`|Progression is intentionally paused pending a resolvable condition.|Unchanged canonical lifecycle state|Clear the blocking condition and rerun the affected gate.|No promotion; retain last honest claim ceiling.|
|`TEMP_CLOSED`|Normative claim/action is fail-closed because required source/fact/anchor is missing or unresolved.|Unchanged canonical lifecycle state|Restore authoritative source/fact, re-ground, then rerun owner decision.|No inference from lower authority or memory.|
|`REWORK_REQUIRED`|A bound validation/verification/admission condition failed and needs correction.|Current honest lifecycle state remains until repaired|Correct affected artifact/implementation; rerun affected tests/gates.|No threshold-lowering or stale PASS reuse.|
|`REJECTED`|An object/decision was explicitly rejected by its authority.|Current honest lifecycle state or terminal decision context|New revision/CR/alternative path with fresh identity.|Rejected object cannot be silently revived.|
|`SUPERSEDED`|A revision is no longer current because a newer valid revision replaced it.|Current lifecycle uses successor only|Preserve provenance; consumers rebind to successor.|Superseded content is forbidden as silent normative fallback.|
|`INVALIDATED`|Previously valid result is no longer reusable for affected scope due to identity/dependency drift.|Last honest lifecycle state for unaffected scope; affected scope blocks|Compute impact graph, recompile/rebind/reverify affected dependents.|Affected evidence/admission/claim cannot be reused.|
These six values **MUST NOT** be injected into `lifecycle_state`. A subject may be, for example, `lifecycle_state=PREDEV_READY` while `degrade_status=TEMP_CLOSED` for one unresolved admission dependency.

# 7｜Lifecycle Constitution C-01～C-14 — Full Substantive Contracts
每個 C-xx 本節都具備 A0 要求的 Purpose / Design intent / Required fields / invariants / Owner / Inputs / Outputs / Consumers / MUST/MUST NOT / Acceptance / Verification / Failure / Cross-DOC / Machine / Positive / Negative dimensions；不得以「另節有」取代本節 boundary/interface。
## C-01｜Project / Product Identity
**Purpose.** 凍結 governed subject 是誰、為誰、在什麼 lifecycle scope 施工。
**Design intent.** 避免同名產品、分支、skill/plugin/harness 或 migration target 被混成同一 subject。
**Required fields.** `system_product_name`, `subject_id`, target actors/users, mission/JTBD, lifecycle scope, target type, greenfield/brownfield/migration mode, explicit non-goals.
**Required invariants.** subject identity stable；同名不同 bytes/revision不等同同一 revision；non-goals不可被 implicit scope expansion 覆寫。
**Owner.** `DOC-01`.
**Inputs.** accepted product/domain truth + scoped task
**Outputs.** ProjectIdentityRecord + non-goal set
**Consumers.** all DOCs, package derivation, evidence binding
**Normative MUST / MUST NOT.** MUST freeze identity before `CONSTITUTION_READY`; MUST NOT infer project identity from filename/brand only.
**Acceptance.** all 5 A3 C-01 atomics materially represented；identity collision test passes。
**Verification.** `TEST-C01-ID`, canonical atomics + wrong-subject mutation.
**Failure behavior.** identity ambiguity → `TEMP_CLOSED`; wrong subject evidence rejected.
**Cross-document reference.** DOC-02 consumes identity for TechnologyAdmission; DOC-03 binds RepoContext; neither rewrites identity.
**Machine representation.** `CommonArtifactMetadata.subject_id` + ProjectIdentityRecord profile.
**Positive case.** system A with migration scope + explicit actors/non-goals binds all artifacts to same stable subject.
**Negative / edge / adversarial case.** same display name but different subject hash/version silently reused → FAIL.
## C-02｜Authority Stack
**Purpose.** 定義誰能改變哪一層 truth，以及 conflict 如何 fail closed。
**Design intent.** 將 current scoped task、product/domain truth、accepted baseline、PI/PD、repo-local mechanics、external support分層，避免 provider/adapter/tool自我升權。
**Required fields.** authority_id/rank/scope/subject/version/hash/owner/effective interval/supersedes.
**Required invariants.** higher-rank wins only within scope；same-rank unresolved conflict=`TEMP_CLOSED`; external support never self-promotes.
**Owner.** `DOC-01`.
**Inputs.** A0→A5b authority sources
**Outputs.** AuthorityRecord / conflict decision
**Consumers.** all normative compilers/adapters
**Normative MUST / MUST NOT.** MUST preserve seven A3 authority children；MUST NOT silent merge conflicts or let tool output become authority.
**Acceptance.** rank table + scope + conflict route machine-resolvable.
**Verification.** `TEST-AUTHORITY`, `OR-AUTHORITY`, conflict mutations for same-rank and provider takeover.
**Failure behavior.** unresolved conflict blocks affected claim/gate only.
**Cross-document reference.** DOC-00 navigation projects authority; adapters only route.
**Machine representation.** AuthorityRecord schema/profile + `DOC01-AUTH-001..007`.
**Positive case.** scoped approved change supersedes older same-subject baseline with explicit lineage.
**Negative / edge / adversarial case.** vendor README conflicts with accepted product truth and is silently merged → FAIL.
## C-03｜Canonical Ownership
**Purpose.** 為每個重要 object/decision指定唯一 writer與受治理 consumers/checkers。
**Design intent.** 避免多 writer、mutation authority leak、projection變第二 SSOT。
**Required fields.** object_id, canonical_writer, readers, checker requirement, human authority, change_route, invalidation_trigger.

**Required invariants.** one semantic object→one canonical writer；delegate/projection cannot mutate canonical semantics；ownership change is explicit breaking change.
**Owner.** `DOC-01`.
**Inputs.** object registry + authority model
**Outputs.** CanonicalOwnershipRecord
**Consumers.** all DOCs/adapters
**Normative MUST / MUST NOT.** MUST materialize writer/readers/checker/human/change route + per-object invalidation trigger；MUST NOT collapse semantic ownership into runtime operator.
**Acceptance.** 5 A3 C-03 atomics + ownership mutation tests close.

# 8｜CONSTITUTION_READY Gate
`CONSTITUTION_READY` is a gate flag under `PI_COMPILING`, not a canonical lifecycle state. `PI_READY` requires it as the first prerequisite.
|ID|Predicate|TRUE iff|FALSE route|
|---|---|---|---|
|`CRDY-01`|`identity_frozen`|Project/product/subject identity, scope and artifact identity are unambiguous and versioned.|`PI_COMPILING` remains; fail closed with scoped diagnosis|
|`CRDY-02`|`authority_resolved`|Authority stack is materialized; no unresolved blocking same-rank conflict remains.|`PI_COMPILING` remains; fail closed with scoped diagnosis|
|`CRDY-03`|`owner_model_resolved`|Canonical writers/readers/checkers/acceptors and change routes are assigned.|`PI_COMPILING` remains; fail closed with scoped diagnosis|
|`CRDY-04`|`permission_model_resolved`|Constitution-level permission/side-effect categories, default-deny and approval boundaries are declared.|`PI_COMPILING` remains; fail closed with scoped diagnosis|
|`CRDY-05`|`lifecycle_states_declared`|The canonical 14-state lifecycle plus side/degrade/projection separation is declared without substitution.|`PI_COMPILING` remains; fail closed with scoped diagnosis|
|`CRDY-06`|`claim_rules_declared`|State/evidence/claim/claim-ceiling rules and forbidden inference rules are materialized.|`PI_COMPILING` remains; fail closed with scoped diagnosis|
|`CRDY-07`|`change_rules_declared`|Versioning, supersession, change classes and affected-only invalidation rules are materialized.|`PI_COMPILING` remains; fail closed with scoped diagnosis|
|`CRDY-08`|`tailoring_profile_selected`|Weight profile and target profile are selected; extensions cannot weaken core invariants.|`PI_COMPILING` remains; fail closed with scoped diagnosis|
Boolean rule:
`CONSTITUTION_READY = identity_frozen ∧ authority_resolved ∧ owner_model_resolved ∧ permission_model_resolved ∧ lifecycle_states_declared ∧ claim_rules_declared ∧ change_rules_declared ∧ tailoring_profile_selected`

|Case|Expected result|Reason|
|---|---|---|
|Seven predicates true, one false|FALSE|Gate is conjunction; no partial pass.|
|Eight booleans true but ownership refs unresolved|FALSE|Predicate evidence is invalid; PP-03/PP-04 fail.|
|DOC-00 displays `CONSTITUTION_READY` from stale projection|FALSE for promotion|Canonical source must be current and subject-bound.|

|All eight current and validated|TRUE|May satisfy the first prerequisite for PI_READY; PI_READY still has additional requirements.|

|`IMPLEMENTED`|Materialized implementation/effect artifacts|`IMPLEMENTATION_MATERIALIZED`|Verification/qualification/release/production|`IMPLEMENTATION_MATERIALIZED`|

### 12.3 SoD Rules
For `ASSURED`/high-risk scope:

# 13｜Permission / Side-Effect Constitution
|Class|Meaning|Required constitutional boundary|Explicitly not granted|
|---|---|---|---|
|`READ_ONLY`|Observe/read/search without mutation.|Normally no mutation approval; still subject to data/security policy.|Writing, installing, binding, deploying or changing external state.|
|`LOCAL_ARTIFACT_WRITE`|Write local non-repo artifacts in an authorized workspace.|Local artifact scope and overwrite rules.|Repo mutation or external side effects.|
|`REPO_WRITE`|Modify version-controlled repository content.|Exact repo/branch/path/change surface and admission.|Implicit network/install/deploy authority.|
|`NETWORK`|Initiate outbound/inbound network interaction beyond already-authorized read context.|Endpoint/purpose/data class/policy; admission where effectful.|Secret use, provider binding or deployment unless separately allowed.|
|`INSTALL`|Install packages/tools/extensions or alter executable environment.|Package/source/version/integrity/license/rollback and admission.|Persistent provider binding or production change.|
|`SECRET_READ`|Read credential/secret material.|Least privilege, explicit subject/scope, approved handling, no exfiltration.|Secret write/rotation/use outside scope.|
|`PROVIDER_BIND`|Bind configuration/credentials/resources to a provider/service.|Exact provider/account/resource/config/rollback and admission.|Deployment or migration unless separately admitted.|
|`DEPLOY`|Create/update deployed service/resource.|Exact target/environment/artifact/rollback/observation and admission.|Migration or production verification by implication.|
|`MIGRATE`|Move data/state/traffic/provider/architecture across boundaries.|Migration plan, parity, rollback window, data/security boundary and admission.|Decommission old path before closure.|
|`ROLLBACK`|Revert an admitted change to a known target.|Known rollback target, authority, evidence/readback.|Unscoped destructive reset.|
|`PRODUCTION_CHANGE`|Any mutation of production/user-visible/world-coupled state.|Highest applicable approval/admission, observability, rollback, effect reconciliation.|Self-approval, inferred permission or claim inflation.|
Three invariants are non-negotiable:
- `permission category definition != authorization issuance`;
- `ECP != ExecutionAdmission`;
- `document/plan/adapter/tool output != permission`.

Each row MUST validate canonical schema and have independent threat identity where semantics differ. Missing owner/residual risk/oracle ⇒ row invalid; material high-risk gap ⇒ HOLD/TEMP_CLOSED.

# 16｜Namespace / Schema Compatibility
The canonical standard is `PIPD-LIFECYCLE-SPEC@1.1.0` with canonical namespace `urn:pipd:canonical-standard:1.1`. Canonical schemas are evaluated against JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 unless a future approved standard revision explicitly migrates them.
|Change level|Allowed semantic effect|Migration requirement|Compatibility claim|
|---|---|---|---|
|Patch|Clarification/bug fix; MUST NOT weaken validation|Document exact change and supersession|Backward compatible unless explicitly narrower with justified validation fix|
|Minor|May add optional fields or intentionally tighten invalid states|Migration note + affected consumer review|Compatibility declared per changed field|
|Major|May change canonical identity/topology/state semantics|Explicit migration plan, supersession and revalidation|No implicit backward/forward compatibility|
Project extensions MAY use organization-owned HTTPS URIs or valid URNs. Final canonical identities **MUST NOT** use placeholder domains. A superseding schema **MUST** state `supersedes`, migration path and backward/forward compatibility. Unknown extension keywords/unsupported schema dialects **MUST** fail closed rather than be silently ignored when they affect validity.
# 17｜Documentation Grounding
A normative authoring record contains:
`source_id`, `source_version`, `source_hash`, `exact_locator`, `grounded_claim`, `retrieval_method`, `state`, `stale_invalidation_trigger`.
For this DOC-01, A0–A5 source bytes and hashes are frozen in §1. When a source revision changes, any claim that consumes changed clauses becomes stale until re-grounded. Search hits alone are not coverage proof; only substantive clauses close a requirement.
**No-Source-No-Norm rule:** missing authoritative source/anchor → `ABSTAIN` for that claim + `TEMP_CLOSED`; no fallback to unbounded historical volumes, model memory, or Web support.
Canonical schema reference: `urn:pipd:canonical-standard:1.1:schema:documentation-grounding`.
# 18｜Change / Supersession / Affected-Only Invalidation — 18/18 Event Retention
## 18.1 Six Canonical Change Classes
`EDITORIAL`, `NON_BREAKING_CONTRACT`, `BREAKING_CONTRACT`, `SECURITY_CURRENTNESS`, `RUNTIME_BINDING_DRIFT`, `EMERGENCY_CHANGE`. `change_class` selects recompile/rebind/retest algorithm；actual invalidation仍由 dependency graph決定。
## 18.2 Affected-Only Algorithm
```text
changed_nodes = exact changed canonical/source/currentness nodes

frontier = reverse_dependencies(changed_nodes)
for each dependent D:
  if changed field intersects D.consumed_contract:
    invalidate D with prior hash + reason + invalidated_by
preserve unrelated nodes
recompute affected gates only
```
**MUST NOT global-reset; MUST NOT stale-reuse.**

# 8｜Architecture / Interface / ABI
§4 contains the component and interface registries. ABI rules: semantic-breaking deltas require CR and affected-only invalidation; compatible additive fields use typed versioned extensions; implementation-binding changes belong to PD; currentness-only changes update CurrentnessRegistry without changing Product Truth or P0 disposition. All external providers terminate at provider-neutral seams; failures are attributed at the seam and cannot silently mutate core state.
# 9｜Search-Before-Build
Canonical algorithm: `need contract → internal reusable capability → admitted internal component → external scout → normalize → fit/gap → reuse → configure/compose → wrap/adapt/translate → bounded extend → BUILD_MINIMAL only after documented NO_FIT → security/rights/license/supply-chain → portability/testability/brownfield → rollback/uninstall/provider-exit → exactly one terminal disposition`. Brand-first, popularity-first, README-first, vendor-first and build-first are non-conformant.

# 18｜Failure / Rollback / Change / Supersession
- `SEMANTIC_CHANGE`: WHAT/WHY/canonical architecture/REQ/acceptance semantics → CR→PI owner.
- `BINDING_CHANGE`: exact repo/provider/host/pin → PD, without changing PI truth.
- `CURRENTNESS_CHANGE`: version/license/security/compatibility fact → CurrentnessRegistry + reassessment; no silent semantic disposition change.
- `TOOL_REPLACEMENT`: preserve capability contract and canonical object identities.
- `SUPERSESSION`: old version becomes non-current and cannot be silently consumed.
- `AFFECTED_ONLY_INVALIDATION`: traverse reverse dependency graph; invalidate only dependent evidence/gates.
- `ROLLBACK`: restore prior subject-bound artifact/adapter state; keep evidence of rollback/residue.
# 19｜Claim Ceiling / State Truth
Allowed: `DESIGN_CONTRACT_COMPLETE`, PI artifacts materialized, Technology design selection complete, and `PI_READY` only for exact slice satisfying §21. Forbidden: selected→installed/bound/enabled; spec→implemented; plan→executed; TQAEP planned→qualified; tool success→world effect; document exists→Independent PASS; PI_READY→ExecutionAdmission.

# H1-01｜Mission / Positioning / Design Intent / Non-Goals
DOC-03 is the canonical **Environment-Binding / Execution-Preparation** writer. It binds an already accepted, current `PI_READY` contract to observed repository/workspace/instruction/runtime/toolchain/provider/protocol/version/permission/environment/migration facts and compiles construction-consumable S2E, TaskSpecSeed, WorkOrder, DEV ECP, OPS ECP, TQAEP and an exact rejectable handoff. It is not a second Product Truth or architecture adjudicator.
## 01.1 PD authority boundary
- PI owns WHAT/WHY/canonical architecture/requirement/acceptance semantics.
- PD owns late-bound HOW/WHERE/WITH-WHAT binding under frozen semantics.
- A repo/runtime fact that merely selects a compatible implementation binding is resolved in PD.
- A fact that changes requirement/interface/acceptance semantics opens a CR and re-enters PI.
- Historical corpus is not re-adjudicated during ordinary PD; it is read only when a current PI trace explicitly requires provenance clarification or a controlled CR reopens scope.
## 01.2 Non-goals
DOC-03 does not install tools, write source code, deploy, migrate, rotate secrets, grant permissions, execute qualification, issue Independent PASS, accept release, or claim Production. It defines the exact preconditions/contracts for those later actions and fails closed when they cannot be bound honestly.
# H1-02｜Inputs / Outputs / Preconditions / Exit Conditions
## 02.1 Mandatory inputs
Frozen PI subject/version/hash and requirement/architecture/acceptance/oracle refs; selected weight+target profiles; current canonical standard/profile pin; read-only access sufficient to observe the target repository/environment; applicable TechnologyAdmission records; known blocking/nonblocking TT; and required instruction surfaces. Missing required normative input => affected scope `TEMP_CLOSED`; missing required external/repo surface => `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL`.
## 02.2 Outputs

`FrozenPIReference`, canonical `RepoContext`, `CurrentnessRecord/CurrentnessDiff`, `LateBoundResolutionLedger`, S2E output, `TaskSpecSeed`, `WorkOrder`, applicable DEV/OPS ECP, TQAEP, `ExecutionHandoffManifest`, `PREDEV_READY` readback, plus TT/CR/invalidation and source-grounding ledgers.
## 02.3 Exit states
`PREDEV_READY` only when every applicable predicate closes; otherwise remain `PREDEV_BINDING`, `HOLD`, `TEMP_CLOSED`, or `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL` as typed. `PREDEV_READY != EXECUTION_ADMITTED`.

# PD-02｜RepoContext / Environment Read-Only Preflight
## 02A Deterministic collection order
1. Resolve repository/workspace root without mutation. 2. Read HEAD/tree/ref/worktree identity. 3. Discover root and all applicable nearest-scope `AGENTS.md`, IDE, policy, build metadata and nested instruction surfaces; hash each. 4. Build module/project structure map. 5. Discover build/test/lint/typecheck/format commands by side-effect-free metadata inspection; commands that require execution remain unexecuted contracts. 6. Read manifests/lockfiles/runtime/toolchain/provider/environment metadata. 7. Observe deployment topology, migration/brownfield state, permission/effect constraints, nonsecret config and opaque secret-handle metadata. 8. Canonicalize and hash RepoContext.
## 02B Canonical shape — no second schema
```yaml
RepoContext:
  repo_root: <absolute-or-host-canonical-path>
  head: <git-commit-or-equivalent-content-id>
  branch_or_ref: <branch/tag/detached-ref>
  worktree_identity: <worktree-id-or-path+head>
  instruction_surfaces:
    - path: <root-or-nested-instruction-file>
      scope: <repo/subtree>
      precedence_basis: <nearest-scope-mechanics-below-canonical-semantics>
      sha256: <digest>
      status: CURRENT|MISSING_REQUIRED|CONFLICT
  project_structure_ref: <module-map-id>
  build_commands: [<read-only-discovered-command-contract-ids>]
  test_commands: [<command-contract-ids>]
  lint_commands: [<command-contract-ids>]
  typecheck_commands: [<command-contract-ids>]
  format_commands: [<command-contract-ids>]
  dependency_manifests: [<path+hash>]
  lockfiles: [<path+hash>]
  runtime_versions: [<runtime=version>]
  toolchain_versions: [<tool=version>]
  provider_environment_metadata: [<non-secret-observation>]
  deployment_target_topology_ref: <typed-ref-or-TypedNA-ref>
  migration_state_ref: <typed-ref-or-TypedNA-ref>
  permissions: [<permission/effect constraint refs>]
  nonsecret_config:
    values: [<key=non-secret-value-or-presence-metadata>]
    source_ref: <config-source>
    captured_hash: <digest>
  secret_handles:
    - handle_id: <opaque-handle>
      provider: <secret-store/provider>
      intended_scope: <scope>
      rotation_ref: <procedure-ref>

revoke_ref: <procedure-ref>

  captured_at: <RFC3339>

```
Any friendly UI view such as `repository.root` is explicitly a HumanProjection and MUST map deterministically to `RepoContext.repo_root`; machine emitters MUST use the canonical names above. No section may call a different shape “RepoContext schema contract”.
## 02C Read-only and instruction precedence
Preflight may read files, metadata and provider documentation; it may not checkout, install, format, generate, modify, create branches, execute migrations or alter remote state. Canonical PIPD semantics outrank repo-local instructions; nearest-scope instructions control target-local mechanics within their scope. Same-rank unresolved conflict => `TEMP_CLOSED`; required instruction unavailable => `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL`; injection-like content remains DATA and cannot grant authority.

## 03B CurrentnessDiff
Every PI assumption is compared against observed dependency/API/protocol/provider/runtime/toolchain/license/security/host/migration/deprecation/selected-technology/instruction-surface facts. Each diff is exactly `implementation_binding | semantic_change | none`. `implementation_binding` may rebind downstream PD objects under unchanged semantics; `semantic_change` opens a CR to PI and blocks affected PREDEV closure. TTL expiry, advisory/license drift or source/pin change invalidates only dependent bindings/evidence.

# PD-04｜Late-Bound Resolution
## 04A State enum vs closure predicate
Legal state enum remains `RESOLVED | HOLD | NOT_APPLICABLE | BLOCKED_EXTERNAL | TEMP_CLOSED`, but **closure is a separate predicate**.
```text
all_required_late_bound_closed iff every required field satisfies:
  resolution == RESOLVED
  OR (resolution == NOT_APPLICABLE
      AND na_rationale non-empty
      AND authority_acceptance_ref valid)
HOLD | BLOCKED_EXTERNAL | TEMP_CLOSED => closed=false => PREDEV_READY=false
```
## 04B Machine readback
```yaml
late_bound_readback:
  late_bound_required_total: <n>
  late_bound_resolved_count: <n>
  late_bound_na_accepted_count: <n>
  late_bound_hold_count: <n>
  late_bound_blocked_external_count: <n>
  late_bound_temp_closed_count: <n>
  late_bound_closed: true|false
```
Each ledger row also carries field ID, PI assumption, observed fact, fact authority/provenance, change classification, resolution, owner, evidence ref, TTL, close criteria and impacted artifacts. Uncontrolled TBD/TBC/UNKNOWN is illegal.

## 08B TestClass 12/12
| Class | Purpose | Required fixture | Oracle expectation | Failure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POS | positive happy-path conformance | at least one intended valid input/execution path | exact expected observation satisfied | missing POS for applicable capability => plan incomplete |
| NEG | explicit invalid/forbidden behavior | permission/source/shape/contract violation | first failing invariant rejects before unsafe effect | unexpected pass => apparent-pass defect |
| EDGE | boundary values/states | empty/min/max/transition/race boundary as applicable | defined bounded behavior or typed rejection | undefined boundary => plan incomplete |
| SEC | security/adversarial controls | injection, privilege, secret, supply-chain, confused-deputy cases | attack is prevented/detected/contained with evidence | security bypass => FAIL/HOLD |
| PERF | performance/SLO/capacity | representative load + accepted NFR | metric meets threshold with tolerance | threshold miss => rework/HOLD |
| PARITY | old/new or provider/path semantic parity | same fixture set across compared subjects | accepted equivalence/delta policy | unexplained delta => HOLD |
| RECOVERY | failure recovery | forced failure at defined checkpoint | recovery returns to admissible state within objective | recovery gap => HOLD |
| UPGRADE | version/protocol/runtime upgrade | old→new supported transition + currentness | compatibility and state migration satisfy policy | breaking drift => CR/rebind/HOLD |
| ROLLBACK | rollback path | mutate then trigger rollback | prior accepted state restored and read back | rollback/residue failure => HOLD |
| UNINSTALL | provider/tool removal | uninstall/provider-off path | dependency healthy and residue predicate satisfied | residue/shared dependency break => HOLD |
| MUT | mutation/apparent-pass resistance | delete/invert decisive field while retaining superficial counts | oracle names first failing invariant | mutant passes => test/oracle insufficient |

| JOURNEY | end-to-end user/operator journey | ordered multi-component scenario | all required gates/effects/evidence link correctly | broken cross-component handoff => FAIL |
## 08C OracleType 8/8
| OracleType | Use | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| DETERMINISTIC | exact equality/boolean/state predicate | stable exact expected result |
| STATE_READBACK | authoritative observed state after action | readback source proves post-state |
| PROPERTY | invariant/property over input/state space | property holds for all tested cases |
| REFERENCE_OUTPUT | compare with accepted reference/golden result | delta within explicit policy |
| STATISTICAL | distribution/metric under repeated trials | confidence/tolerance criterion satisfied |
| SEMANTIC_JUDGE | bounded semantic rubric where exact oracle unavailable | rubric + calibration + independent evidence required |
| HUMAN | authorized human judgment for non-automatable acceptance | named role + decision record + evidence basis |
| COMPOSITE | two or more independent oracle types | all mandatory component oracles satisfy composition rule |
## 08D Qualification gates G00-G14 — 15/15
| Gate | Name | Pass predicate | Failure behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| G00 | PARENT MOUNT | required parent/source mount and hashes available | fail closed before qualification |
| G01 | PACKAGE EXACT-SET | required artifact/package identity set complete | missing/duplicate identity fails |
| G02 | AGENT SKILLS FORMAT | skill/package format conforms where applicable | format mismatch fails |
| G03 | SKILL ROUTING / NONTRIGGER / OVERLAP | trigger/non-trigger/overlap rules deterministic | ambiguous routing fails |
| G04 | SOURCE / ECP BINDING | source, WorkOrder and applicable ECP exact refs bound | wrong/stale binding fails |
| G05 | QUALIFICATION PROFILE | target/weight profile + applicable tests resolved | profile gap fails |
| G06 | CANDIDATE IDENTITY / INSTALL | candidate identity and install/binding evidence separated | wrong candidate or selection-as-install fails |
| G07 | FUNCTIONAL CONFORMANCE | functional POS/NEG/EDGE contract satisfied | first functional invariant failure blocks |
| G08 | PERFORMANCE / SPEC / JOURNEY | performance/spec/journey acceptance met | threshold/journey failure blocks |
| G09 | SECURITY / RESILIENCE | security, recovery, abuse and resilience tests pass | security/resilience failure blocks |
| G10 | REPAIR / REQUALIFICATION | repairs invalidate affected evidence and rerun required scope | stale pre-repair PASS rejected |
| G11 | EVIDENCE NORMALIZATION | evidence schema/subject/freshness/retention valid | foreign/stale/untyped evidence rejected |
| G12 | CROSS-SKILL / CLAIM / MUTATION / NRTV | cross-component claim integrity + mutation resistance | false closure or NRTV regression fails |
| G13 | HOST INSTALL / BINDING | host-specific install/binding proven where required | planned/selected cannot substitute |
| G14 | INDEPENDENT ASSURANCE HANDOFF | complete packet transferred to independent checker/acceptor | author self-PASS cannot close independent gate |

# H1-04｜PD Binding Algorithm — Normative Procedure
| Step | Normative action |
|---|---|
| 1 | Validate canonical standard/profile/source lock and Frozen PI subject/version/hash. |
| 2 | Validate PI_READY and target-slice dependency closure; reject stale/superseded/wrong-subject inputs. |
| 3 | Select weight profile and target profile; materialize all applicable denominators or TypedNA. |
| 4 | Collect RepoContext read-only, including all applicable nearest-scope instructions and hashes. |
| 5 | Canonicalize RepoContext and compute content hash; reject any preflight mutation. |
| 6 | Refresh CurrentnessRecords for every selected/eval Layer-A item and every project runtime dependency. |
| 7 | Compute CurrentnessDiff; route semantic_change to PI CR and stop affected binding. |
| 8 | Create LateBoundResolution rows; do not count HOLD/BLOCKED_EXTERNAL/TEMP_CLOSED as closed. |
| 9 | Compile S2E under frozen semantics. |
| 10 | Emit TaskSpecSeed; assert execution_authority=false. |
| 11 | Emit exactly bounded WorkOrder(s); assert one Seed ref per WorkOrder and no self-authorization. |
| 12 | Materialize DEV ECP with scope, command, policy, checkpoint, retry/stop, rollback/recovery, evidence and SoD. |
| 13 | Materialize OPS ECP 32-child contracts or child-specific authority-accepted TypedNA. |
| 14 | Materialize TQAEP with 12 TestClasses, 8 OracleTypes, G00-G14, host/provider/currentness/evidence bindings. |
| 15 | Materialize exact rejectable handoff with machine-representable none_reason. |
| 16 | Evaluate package split/merge and dependency-closed vertical-slice boundary. |
| 17 | Run identity inequalities Seed != WO != ECP != Admission and high-risk SoD policy. |
| 18 | Run PREDEV_READY evaluator using closed-state—not terminal-state—semantics. |
| 19 | Run DSTR-01..DSTR-25 author-side destructive suite; any failure blocks author-side repair closure. |
| 20 | Issue handoff to DOC-05/receiver for ACK/NACK and independent ExecutionAdmission; no mutation occurs here. |

Re-running the algorithm with unchanged frozen inputs and observed environment MUST be idempotent at the semantic object level. Any input/hash/currentness/profile drift triggers affected-only invalidation and rerun from the earliest impacted step.
# H1-05｜PREDEV_READY Gate
| Predicate | Required truth |
|---|---|
| PDR-01 | Frozen PI refs valid/current/subject-hash matched |
| PDR-02 | RepoContext canonical shape complete; collection was read-only; applicable instructions resolved |
| PDR-03 | Required currentness records fresh enough for target slice; semantic_change CR count=0 |
| PDR-04 | late_bound_closed=true with HOLD=0, BLOCKED_EXTERNAL=0, TEMP_CLOSED=0 among required fields |
| PDR-05 | S2E complete and execution_authority=false |
| PDR-06 | TaskSpecSeed and WorkOrder complete; Seed ID != WorkOrder ID |
| PDR-07 | Applicable DEV ECP complete; WorkOrder ID != ECP ID; ECP.execution_authority=false |
| PDR-08 | Applicable OPS ECP 32-child closure complete or child-specific accepted TypedNA |
| PDR-09 | TQAEP construction-ready: 12/8/G00-G14 applicability resolved; no PASS inference |
| PDR-10 | Permission/Human prerequisites represented; no missing required approval path |

# H1-06A｜Package Derivation / Split / Merge / Vertical-Slice Execution
## 06A.1 Split predicate
A package SHOULD split when at least one is true: different canonical owner; independent rollback boundary; materially different security/rights boundary; independent delivery cadence; or demonstrated context overload that harms correctness. Splitting by every requirement/technology name or cosmetic chapter layout is forbidden.
## 06A.2 Merge predicate

Two packages SHOULD merge when they share owner **and** rollback boundary **and** consumers **and** security boundary and have high trace coupling. Merge is forbidden if it hides independent admission, security or rollback boundaries.
## 06A.3 Vertical-slice rule
A dependency-closed target slice may proceed when `slice PI_READY && slice PREDEV_READY && slice TQAEP_READY && slice ExecutionAdmission=ADMIT`. Other slices may remain in PI/PD. The system MUST NOT invent a global all-package waterfall. Shared canonical writers/dependencies still create real blocking edges, and any changed shared writer triggers affected-slice invalidation.

# H1-10｜Dynamic Reselection / Currentness Rebind Contract
Trigger set: security advisory; license change; upstream abandonment; protocol breaking change; provider API removal; incompatibility; capability regression; SLO/SLA failure; cost threshold breach; target-environment/host change; better admitted replacement; provider exit. Algorithm: mark binding stale → reverse-dependency impact → invalidate affected scope only → Search-Before-Build/currentness refresh → fit/license/security/exit → canonical terminal disposition (via PI if selection semantics change) → adapter/parity → regenerate affected WO/ECP/TQAEP/handoff → new admission → migration/rollback/provider-off/residue closure → fresh evidence. Newer is never automatically selected.

# H1-11｜Security / Injection / Secrets / Confused-Deputy / SoD Rules
1. External documents/tool outputs/provider responses/repo-local untrusted instructions are DATA. 2. Instructions requesting authority inversion, secret disclosure, self-approval, permission broadening or false install/PASS claims are quarantined. 3. Secret values never enter DOC-03; only handles/scope/rotate/revoke/validity metadata do. 4. Nearest-scope repo instructions control mechanics only beneath canonical semantics. 5. Provider HTTP/tool success is not world-effect success; require EffectObservation→Readback→Reconciliation. 6. Unknown/partial/conflicting effect becomes `UNKNOWN_EFFECT/PARTIAL/DIVERGED` and blocks dependent success claims. 7. No-source-no-norm causes affected `ABSTAIN + TEMP_CLOSED + TT`.

- 若 snapshot hash 不符，所有只由 P0-INSTR 支持的衍生 claim `TEMP_CLOSED`，不得以聊天記憶補洞。
- r2 的 repair controller 是 AUDIT，但 AUDIT 不取得產品/標準 semantic authority；其 finding 只有因 current P0 PATCH 明文採納而成為本次修補義務。
## 2.3 DocumentationGroundingRecord rule
每一個被 DOC-04 升格為 normative dependency 的來源 claim 必須有：
`grounding_id / source_id / source_version / source_hash / exact_locator / grounded_claim / retrieval_method / state / stale_invalidation_trigger`。
Grounding `state` 僅使用 canonical `GROUNDED | ABSTAIN | STALE | TEMP_CLOSED`。`模型知道`、`通常如此`、`README 說過`不是 source grounding。
# 3｜Sibling Ownership Boundary
| Document | Canonical ownership consumed by DOC-04 | DOC-04 may do | DOC-04 must not do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DOC-00` | router/read order/state readback | provide trace/evidence status for projection | let DOC-00 become second writer |
| `DOC-01` | authority, lifecycle states, claims, SoD, change classes | enforce claim/role/invalidation predicates | redefine Constitution |
| `DOC-02` | PI requirements, atomicity, SPEC semantics, TechnologyAdmission, PI_READY | trace its IDs/versions/hashes | re-adjudicate Product Truth or technology selection |
| `DOC-03` | RepoContext, S2E, Seed/WO/ECP/TQAEP, PREDEV_READY | bind returned evidence to PD subjects | treat preparation object as execution authority |
| `DOC-05` | rejectable handoff, permission/effect intent, admission, rollback | own observation/reconciliation data contract and evidence promotion rule | grant permission or ADMIT |
| `DOC-06` | LITE/STANDARD/ASSURED + target profiles | apply profile-added evidence/test depth | let profile remove portable-core invariants |
| `DOC-07` | test/oracle/fixture reference and destructive verification | bind stable TEST/ORACLE IDs to trace/evidence | become second fixture/oracle catalog |
| `DOC-08` | AI adapter/read-order maturity | expose machine-readable trace for adapters | copy normative truth into prompts |
| `DOC-09` | CI/release/supply-chain/runbook/tooling | accept verified CI/attestation receipts as evidence artifacts | equate CI success with product acceptance |
**Seam rule:** DOC-04 owns *proof-path integrity*；sibling DOCs own the semantics of the objects being proved. A reference may be copied; canonical ownership may not.
# 4｜Requirement Narrow Waist — Node and Edge Contract
## 4.1 Node identity
| Node | Identity source | Canonical writer | Required identity material | Terminal/holding semantics |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SRC` | source registry / grounding | source owner + DOC-04 grounding | source ID, version, hash, exact locator, authority | GROUNDED / ABSTAIN / STALE / TEMP_CLOSED |
| `INTENT` | DOC-01/02 product/intent contract | DOC-01/02 | stable ID, owner, source refs, version/hash | CURRENT / SUPERSEDED / INVALIDATED |
| `REQ` | DOC-02 | DOC-02 | parent/child IDs, owner, criticality, applicability | CURRENT / HOLD / NOT_APPLICABLE / SUPERSEDED / INVALIDATED |
| `SPEC` | DOC-02 or owning sibling | owning sibling | stable ID, machine/prose locator, version/hash | CURRENT / HOLD / N/A / SUPERSEDED / INVALIDATED |
| `ACC` | PI contract | owning requirement domain; traced by DOC-04 | stable ID, observable predicate, checker, acceptor | DEFINED / HELD / SUPERSEDED / INVALIDATED |
| `VER` | DOC-07 registry / domain verifier | DOC-07 or domain verifier | TEST ID, ORACLE ID, fixture/method version | DEFINED / NOT_EXECUTED / EXECUTED |
| `EVD_EXPECTATION` | PI/TQAEP planning | DOC-04 data contract + producer domain | evidence type, subject, procedure, freshness, checker | CURRENT / STALE / N/A |
| `EVD` | execution/verification receiver | evidence producer | canonical evidence packet + assurance metadata | PASS / FAIL / HOLD / NOT_EXECUTED / UNKNOWN |
| `DEL` | delivery owner | package/project owner | deliverable ID, completion predicate, hash | CURRENT / INCOMPLETE / STALE |
| `GATE` | Constitution / gate owner | DOC-01/05/07/09 as applicable | denominator, decision owner, blocking class | OPEN / HOLD / CLOSED / DENIED |
| `PD_BINDING` | DOC-03 | DOC-03 | PI ref, repo/env/currentness/frozen refs | CURRENT / STALE / REJECTED |
`RequirementTraceRow` 是 narrow waist 的 canonical row，但 `PD_BINDING` 與 richer evidence metadata 不得被硬塞進 canonical schema 造成第二版本；DOC-04 以 typed companion ledgers + deterministic semantic validator補足，不與 canonical schema 競爭。
## 4.2 Edge invariants
1. 每個 normative `REQ` 必須至少有一個 `SRC` 或合法 inherited source ref。
2. `REQ→SPEC→ACC→VER→EVD_EXPECTATION` 是設計期 closure；`EVD` 是執行後 actual evidence，兩者不得合併。
3. `EVD` 必須回指 owning expectation；foreign evidence 不能靠相似名稱接入。
4. `DEL→GATE→PD_BINDING` 讓 trace 延伸到 receiver 可消費狀態；evidence 不是終點。
5. 每條 forward edge 必須可由 reverse index回溯到 consumed contract。
6. 任何 edge 的 subject/version/hash 改變，只 invalidates 真正 consume 該欄位的 dependents。
# 5｜Parent Requirement → Atomic Child Requirements
複合句只要含「各有、分別、對應、每個、同時、至少 A 與 B」等可獨立驗證義務，就必須先拆成 atomic children。父 requirement 不直接取得 PASS；它的 closure 是孩子集合的 deterministic reduction。
```text
decompose(parent):
  identify independently observable obligations
  create stable child IDs
  bind exactly one canonical owner per child
  bind applicability and criticality
  require SPEC/ACC/VER/EVD_EXPECTATION for each applicable child
  reject empty or circular child set
```
父層 closure：
```text
if any applicable child is INVALIDATED or HOLD:
    parent = HOLD
elif any applicable child lacks SPEC/ACC/VER/EVD_EXPECTATION:
    parent = HOLD + scoped TT
elif every child is NOT_APPLICABLE with accepted typed rationale:
    parent = NOT_APPLICABLE
else:

parent trace = CURRENT
```
`CURRENT` 只表示 trace contract current，不表示 runtime PASS。若 child-3 semantic contract改變，只 child-3 與 consuming dependents stale；child-1/2 若不 consume該 contract，保持 current。
# 6｜SPEC Linkage Contract
DOC-04 不寫 SPEC 內容；它寫 **SPEC identity、ownership 與 consumption relation**。
- 一個 `REQ` 可映射一或多個 SPEC，前提是每個 SPEC 都有明確 consumed obligation；
- 多個 `REQ` 可共享 SPEC，但不得因共享而失去各自 Acceptance / Evidence expectation；
- `spec_ref` 必須可解析到 canonical owner 的 exact locator；
- SPEC version/hash 改變時，reverse index計算 affected requirements；
- SPEC 缺失不能以 `N/A` 掩蓋；只有 requirement 在 profile/applicability 下真正不適用時才可 N/A；
- orphan SPEC 代表「存在 canonical SPEC 但沒有 requirement consumer」，需分類成 retired/support-only/defect；不得默認忽略；
- machine-consumability 至少要求 stable ID、version/hash、schema/contract locator 或 deterministic prose predicate。
若 DOC-02 已裁決 SPEC semantic truth，DOC-04 只能 consume/pin/reference，不得重寫。
# 7｜Acceptance Contract
`AcceptancePredicate` 是 requirement 的可判定成功／拒收條件。每個重要 requirement 至少包含：
| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| `acceptance_id` | stable、不可由顯示標題推導 |
| `requirement_ref` | exact parent/atomic requirement |
| `preconditions` | 執行判定前必須成立的條件 |
| `observable_success` | 可由人/工具/複合 oracle觀察的狀態 |
| `negative_predicate` | 明確禁止或必須拒收的狀態 |
| `edge_boundary_predicate` | 邊界/極限條件 |
| `tolerance_confidence` | 數值 tolerance、statistical confidence 或 exact |
| `checker` | 技術檢查責任 slot |
| `acceptor` | 技術/業務 acceptance責任 slot |
| `evidence_expected` | owning EvidenceExpectation refs |
| `profile_criteria` | LITE/STANDARD/ASSURED/target profile增量 |
| `failure_semantics` | FAIL/HOLD/TEMP_CLOSED與第一失敗 invariant |
「看起來正常」「結果合理」「人工確認即可」不是 acceptance predicate。Human judgment 若必要，必須有具體 rubric、輸入、評分尺度、最小通過條件、身份與 timestamp。
# 8｜Verification / Oracle Linkage
DOC-04 把 Acceptance 綁到 `TEST/ORACLE` identity，但不聲稱測試已執行。
每個 verification binding 必須記錄：
- stable `TEST-*` ID；
- stable `OR-*` ID；
- verification method；
- fixture/input identity + version/hash；
- expected observation；
- expected first failing invariant；
- oracle class：`DETERMINISTIC | STATISTICAL | HUMAN | COMPOSITE`；

- execution boundary / required environment；
- requalification trigger；
- oracle version/supersession；
- profile-added test identity與不可移除 core test規則。
若 writer 修改 oracle 以讓自己通過，舊 evidence 必須 stale，且該 writer 的新結果不可被標示為 independent assurance。Profiles 可增加 test，但不得移除 applicable core test；唯一例外是 accepted typed N/A。
# 9｜Evidence Expectation — Plan Before Evidence
`EvidenceExpectation` 是「之後需要什麼證據才能關閉某 predicate」；它與 actual `EVD` 嚴格分離。
最低 typed ledger：
```yaml
expectation_id: EVDX-D04-NORM-001
acceptance_ref: ACC-D04-EXAMPLE-001
verification_ref: TEST-D04-EXAMPLE-001
evidence_type: functional
subject_selector:
  subject_id: SVC-EXAMPLE
  version_policy: exact
  hash_policy: exact_sha256
expected_location: "evidence://functional/SVC-EXAMPLE"
collection_procedure_ref: PROC-D04-EXAMPLE-001
environment_policy: "ENV-PROFILE-EXAMPLE-001"
retention_policy: "PROJECT_PLUS_180D"
freshness_policy: "subject_or_oracle_change_invalidates; max_age=30d"
checker_role: ROLE-CHECKER
replay_requirement: "REPLAYABLE_WITH_PINNED_FIXTURE"
security_privacy_class: INTERNAL
world_effect_requirement: NOT_APPLICABLE
invalidation_triggers:
  - SUBJECT_HASH_CHANGE
  - ORACLE_VERSION_CHANGE
  - PROCEDURE_VERSION_CHANGE
```
此 typed ledger不是新的 `evidence.schema.json`。它是 DOC-04 semantic layer，允許 machine validator檢查 `EVD_EXPECTATION != EVD`：
```text
PLAN_COMPLETE != EXECUTED
TEST_DEFINED != TEST_EXECUTED
EVIDENCE_EXPECTED != EVIDENCE_RETURNED
```
# 10｜Subject-Bound Evidence Packet
## 10.1 Canonical packet denominator
`urn:pipd:canonical-standard:1.1:schema:evidence` 的 `SubjectBoundEvidencePacket` canonical required fields為：

`evidence_id, subject_id, subject_version, subject_hash, fixture_or_input_refs, environment, procedure_ref, expected, actual, oracle, oracle_result, result, timestamp, producer, first_failing_invariant, invalidated_dependents, artifacts`。
Canonical optional fields包括 `checker, approval_ref, effect_reconciliation_ref, rollback_result, residue_result`。`result=PASS` 時 canonical schema要求 non-empty `checker`、`oracle_result=PASS` 且至少一個 hashed artifact。
## 10.2 Assurance metadata overlay without schema fork
Skeleton/本任務還要求 operator、payload ref、test/oracle refs、freshness、retention、replay、effect observation/reconciliation。因 canonical evidence schema `additionalProperties=false`，DOC-04 **不得**偷偷往 canonical packet塞新欄位；r2 改以 keyed companion records保存，並由 §25 的 `DOC04ValidationProfile` 做 cross-object validation。
```yaml
evidence_id: EVD-D04-NORM-001
operator: ROLE-OPERATOR
payload_ref: artifact://evidence/raw-result.json
test_oracle_refs: [TEST-D04-EXAMPLE-001, OR-D04-EXAMPLE-001]
freshness:
  observed_at: "2026-10-07T10:00:00+08:00"
  expires_at: "2026-11-06T10:00:00+08:00"
  state: CURRENT
retention:
  class: PROJECT_PLUS_180D
  minimum_until: "2027-04-05T10:00:00+08:00"
replay:
  mode: PINNED_FIXTURE
  fixture_ref: FIX-D04-EXAMPLE-001
effect_observation_ref: null
reconciliation_ref: null
```
### 10.3 ExecutionEvidenceReturnLedger — executor-grade raw carrier
Canonical `SubjectBoundEvidencePacket` 保存 acceptance/evidence truth；executor 的 raw transport details 由下列 companion ledger承載，不改 canonical 22 schemas：
```yaml
return_id: EVRET-D04-EXAMPLE-001

subject_id: SVC-D04-EXAMPLE
subject_version: "1.0.0"
subject_hash: "d3c5bb22f8408c835133db8e0380a741b7ab03f43d4b9154ebbf6435dd4f258f"
operation_id: OP-D04-EXAMPLE-001

ended_at: "2026-10-07T10:00:03+08:00"
environment: ENV-D04-EXAMPLE-001
producer: ROLE-MAKER

command_or_action: "HTTP GET /healthz against pinned local fixture"
exit_or_provider_status: "exit=0 / status=200"

stdout_ref: artifact://d04/example/stdout.txt
stderr_ref: artifact://d04/example/stderr.txt
raw_result_ref: artifact://d04/example/raw-result.json
changed_artifacts:
  - ref: artifact://d04/example/output.json
    sha256: "280db14100b375b4b8d6235149bce126596d6b17133a060ea70a1516f9042125"
```
